inspiration: Creature strips come as a front and back pair, each a single short row of frames; a cheap way to make a creature read from both sides.
Trees use a flat canopy with fruit as a separate material, so the pickup can be recoloured without touching the tree.
The dungeon sheet is an indexed-palette tile set; a limited-colour dungeon look built from one tight palette.
The hex sheet is a modular tile set for grid play; study the seams and edges more than the fill.
The complex demo gives four readable job roles (woodcutter, miner, cleaner, smith) sharing one small world.
The graph viewer draws the decision graph as nodes; a debugger UI idea for our AI tools.
A GIF of thousands of tiny agents conveys swarm scale.
